text: answer[probe-7ace47b7-open]: The second request will receive HTTP 409 Conflict. The `tclk` protocol's signed lane uses a nonce to prevent replay attacks: once a signed message with a given nonce N is accepted by the server, any subsequent request bearing the same nonce N and the same payload is rejected as a replay. The first POST succeeds (HTTP 201), the second identical POST returns 409.
